description: A small round glass flask with a cork stopper, filled with glowing red liquid that catches the light.
A single curved, thick bear claw, dark brown fading to bone-yellow at the tip, with a rough worn surface.
A rolled-up parchment scroll, aged cream-colored paper bound with a thin twine tie, slightly frayed at the ends.
A tall slender glass flask with a cork stopper, filled with luminous deep blue liquid.
A small wide-shouldered glass vial with a cork stopper, filled with pale green liquid, a cloth label tied at the neck.
A small teardrop glass vial with a cork stopper, filled with bright swirling yellow liquid.
A folded tan deer hide with a soft cream underside, short fur and rolled edges.
A small square of soft brown and white rabbit fur, fluffy and loosely folded.
A scrap of coarse grey rat hide, ragged along the edges, stiff and worn.
A single long thin pink-grey rat tail, faintly scaly, curved into a loose hook.
A thick raw red cut of meat with pale marbled fat and a white bone end.
Two thin lean strips of dark red raw meat, slightly curled.
A single bushy red-brown squirrel tail, thick fur, curved into an S shape.
A large grey wolf hide with darker guard hairs, folded into a heavy bundle.
A glob of translucent green jelly, rounded and glossy, holding a soft blobby shape.
A puddle-shaped blob of thick olive-green ooze, glossy, with a few dripping strands.
A tightly rolled cream parchment scroll bound with a red wax seal, edges slightly curled.
A short wooden handle bound with pitch-soaked cloth at one end, unlit, rough bark texture.
A thick shaggy brown bear hide, coarse and heavy, folded into a loose bundle.
A large patch of coarse mangy brown-grey fur, ragged at the edges.
A single round copper coin, warm reddish-brown, a simple stamped emblem and a worn rim.
A single round gold coin, bright yellow, a stamped emblem and a milled rim.
A plump brown leather drawstring pouch cinched with a cord, worn and rounded.
A small thick leather-bound book with a cracked cover, a cord tie and dog-eared pages.
A round disc of thick sea-green glass, polished smooth, with a salt-crusted rim.
A small carved wooden bird on a short leather cord, painted in faded colors.
A folded parchment letter with a broken red wax seal and a dark stain across one corner.
A single thick curved yellow-grey claw, cracked and worn at the tip.
A jagged shard of pale blue-green glass, sharp edged and faintly translucent.
A crude bone amulet on a thin leather cord, carved with a rough spiral and strung with a small green bead.
A single severed pointed green ear, notched along the top edge.
A faceted crystal sphere glowing pale blue from within, held in a small bronze cage.
An angular crystal shard with glossy faces shifting between violet, teal and pink.
A bent rusted strip of iron plate, pitted with orange rust and torn at one end.
A sliver of mirrored glass wrapped in pale silver light, its face bright and reflective.
A heavy silver ring with a flat engraved crest on the face and a tarnished band.
A curved wedge of clear lens glass splitting light into faint rainbow bands.
A single narrow yellow-white fang, slightly curved, with a dark root end.
A small crude crown of twisted grey wire and bone set with one dull red stone.
A long shard of pale glass with a faint humming glow running along its cracks.
A crumpled wad of bent scrap metal and torn cloth bound together with wire.
A single weathered bone, pale and cracked, knobbed at both ends.
A water-stained parchment sheet covered in faded ink columns, corners curled.
A small spiral seashell with a pearlescent pink and blue inner sheen.
A translucent membranous sac bulging with pale green fluid, glossy surface.
A tight bundle of pale grey silken thread wound into a loose skein.
A single large brown acorn with a textured cap.
A ragged piece of dull brown hide, torn along one edge, patchy and stiff.
A broken chunk of carved dark wood with part of a crude painted face still visible.
A jagged pale crystal shard with faint blurred motion lines at its edges.
A plain steel short sword with a straight crossguard and a leather-wrapped grip, blade upright.
A light tan leather cuirass with shoulder straps and simple stitching.
A rolled parchment scroll tied at the middle with a thin cord.
A small brown drawstring sack tied at the neck, plump and rounded.
